title: 云计算和 SaaS 领域的结构性变化和创新
core_insight: AWS、Salesforce、Google Cloud 和 Cloudflare 等公司在云计算和 SaaS 领域取得了显著进展，包括新技术、基础设施和应用层的创新

dimension_texts.technology: AWS 和 Google Cloud 推出了新版 Kubernetes 版本回滚功能和 C4N 虚拟机，提高了容器化部署的可靠性和网络性能 AWS 和 Google Cloud 推出了新的 EC2 实例类型和虚拟机，采用 AWS Graviton5 处理器和网络优化技术，提供更高的计算性能和网络吞吐量 AWS Weekly Roundup: Claude Sonnet 5 on AWS, Amazon WorkSpaces for AI agents, AWS service availability updates, and more Upgrade Amazon EKS clusters with confidence using Kubernetes version rollbacks C4N, now GA: Delivering cloud’s highest per vCPU network and block storage I/O for x86 workloads Built to bounce back: How Azure resiliency evolved 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品 将持续完善敏捷数智引擎矩阵 Unmasking the crawls with Attribution Business Insights How we built saga rollbacks for Cloudflare Workflows Unlocking the Cloudflare app ecosystem with OAuth for all
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS 和 Google Cloud 推出了新的定价模式和虚拟机，可能会改变云计算市场的价格竞争 AWS 和 Google Cloud 推出了新的 EC2 实例类型和虚拟机，提供更高的计算性能和网络吞吐量 Accelerate your infrastructure deployments by up to 4x with AWS CloudFormation Express mode Amazon EC2 C9g and C9gd instances powered by AWS Graviton5 processors are now available C4N, now GA: Delivering cloud’s highest per vCPU network and block storage I/O for x86 workloads 布局云计算，火山引擎的技术发展之路 Your Worker can now have its own cache in front of it
dimension_texts.application: Salesforce 和 HubSpot 发布了新的 AI 代理功能和 CRM 功能，进一步扩大了其在客户关系管理市场的影响力 Salesforce 和 HubSpot 的新功能有助于企业实现数字化转型 What You Can Learn From Two Marketing Cloud Next Onboarding Journeys How Batteries Plus Reengaged Customers to Generate $15M in Pipeline with a Lean Team CRM administration: Roles and best practices guide Making AI search smarter 刘润：一篇文章讲清楚，什么是火山引擎
